metadata.title: Marvell's AI Rally Runs Into a Price Check

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Marvell Technology (MRVL, Financials) has become one of the more exciting names in the AI infrastructure trade.
The reason is simple. AI data centers need more than GPUs. They also need fast networking, custom chips and better ways to move data between thousands of processors. That is where Marvell fits in.
The stock has rallied hard as investors began looking beyond Nvidia and memory names for the next layer of the AI buildout. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's praise for Marvell only added fuel to that move.
Marvell's custom silicon work with large cloud companies is also part of the appeal. These projects can last years and are not easy for customers to switch away from once they are in place.
But the stock is no longer cheap. After the recent jump, investors are paying a steep price for future growth.
That does not mean the story is broken. It means Marvell now has to deliver. Strong AI demand may keep helping the company, but the market already expects a lot.
